name: Slider
propertyCopy: Track thickness, label text and value are properties of the same component, not separate sliders - change them below to check both types and every state in the Live Preview. There is no configurable corner radius: the track and thumb are always a full pill shape, since a slider control has no practical use for sharp or partial corners.
guide: Component Guide Human View Machine View Overview Slider lets someone pick a numeric value, or a range of two values, by dragging a thumb along a track - used for continuous or coarse-grained values where the exact number matters less than quickly finding the right position, like a volume level or a price filter. When to Use A value picked along a continuous scale - volume, brightness, zoom level. A bounded range of two values - a price range filter with a low and high thumb. A scrubber for position within a duration - a progress scrubber. When Not to Use A value that needs precise, exact keyboard entry - use Number instead - dragging is imprecise for exact values like "37". A choice from a small set of discrete, named options - use Group Button, Radio, or Select rather than a slider with only a few valid stops. A single date or time value - use Date Picker or Time - a slider doesn't communicate calendar or clock context. Best Practices Show the current value as text alongside the track, since position alone is hard to read precisely. Choose a track thickness and thumb size that stay comfortably draggable on touch as well as with a mouse. Support arrow-key adjustment in fixed increments as an alternative to dragging. Do and Don't Do Opacity - 60% An approximate setting the user judges by eye, with the current value shown so the choice is still repeatable. Don't Invoice amount A slider cannot hit an exact figure, and no value is shown to confirm one. Anything that must be precise belongs in a Number field. Accessibility Exposed with proper slider role semantics, including the current value, minimum, and maximum, all announced to assistive technology. Fully operable by keyboard - arrow keys adjust the value, Home/End jump to the bounds. The focus ring appears on the thumb itself, independent of any hover-only styling.
